name: Robins AFB
description: Robins AFB is home to the 78th Air Base Wing and Air Force Materiel Command's Warner Robins Air Logistics Complex — the largest industrial complex in Georgia. A major sustainment hub for C-130, F-15, and special-mission aircraft supporting global combat readiness.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass through the Visitor Control Center at Gate 3.

gates.name: Watson Gate (Gate 3)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate and only gate open nights, weekends, and holidays. Visitor Control Center in Bldg 219. Can issue visitor passes when VCC is closed (up to 72 hours).
gates.address: Watson Blvd & GA-247, Warner Robins, GA 31093

gates.name: Green Street Gate (Gate 1)
gates.notes: Closed weekends and federal holidays. Popular weekday commuter gate for north Warner Robins and Centerville.

gates.name: Russell Parkway Gate (Gate 14)
gates.notes: Daily access gate serving Bonaire, Kathleen, Perry, and Byron corridors. Closed 2200-0500.

gates.name: Truck Gate (Gate 4)
gates.notes: Commercial vehicle and truck traffic gate. Closed weekends and federal holidays.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Gate 3)
gates.notes: Passes and registration in Bldg 219 at Watson Gate. DBIDS background checks, contractor badges, and family passes. REAL ID required.
gates.address: Bldg 219, Watson Blvd, Warner Robins, GA 31093

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your Unit Command Support Staff (CSS) normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center. Visit MPF in Bldg 767 for personnel actions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HMO before signing any off-base lease. Pine Oaks Lodge offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: Watson Gate (Gate 3) is open 24/7. Green Street Gate 1 is Mon-Fri 0500-1800. Russell Parkway Gate 14 is daily 0500-2200. Truck Gate 4 is Mon-Fri 0600-1800. Visitor Control Center hours are Mon-Fri 0715-1630. REAL ID required for all visitors.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
